messages:
Harper: Quick non-work emergency: who stole my office cactus? last seen on my windowsill, now it's on the couch doing yoga. :cactus: :eyes:
Jin: That would be me. I moved it to start 'Couch Plant Olympics'. training for synchronized photosynthesis. :sweat_smile:
Suri: rules? events? I want to enter my philodendron. it has form.
Harper: Fine. but return my cactus if it loses to a fern. stakes: you bring snacks tomorrow. :muffin:
bento-bot: Lunch reminder: sushi special today at 12:30 in kitchen. :bento: (automated)
Jin: Challenge accepted. Fern category looks tough though. also one-liner side bet: best plant pun wins an extra soy sauce packet. drop puns now.
Suri: "Leaf it to me to win."
Harper: "I'm frond of this competition."
Jin: "This is unbeleafable talent."
Suri: solid entries. emoji vote: Harpers for :star:, Jin for :trophy:, Suri for :leaves:
Harper: :star:
Jin: :trophy:
Suri: :leaves:
Harper: tie! we'll settle with rock-paper-scissors over lunch.
Jin: also quick kudos: thanks @Suri for rescuing the meeting room chairs last week. they were rebelling. :chair: :clap:
Suri: haha those chairs are drama queens. happy to help.
bento-bot: Reaction summary: Harper (1), Jin (1), Suri (1)
Harper: OK plant Olympics is a go. cactus stays on the couch until finals. snacks tomorrow on Jin.
Jin: deal. I will bring snacks and extra tiny flags for podiums. :flag_white: :flag_black:
Suri: see you all at noon. may the best leaf win. :leaf_fluttering_in_wind:
